drawio_review_note: Aligned with LongCat-Image arXiv:2512.07584 Section 5.1 Poster&SceneBench and Table 8. SceneBench is the natural-scene-text portion of the internal Poster&SceneBench evaluation in the LongCat-Image report, not the unrelated Scene-Bench dataset. The authors curate 500 prompts jointly covering poster typography and natural scene text; they do not disclose the split count, source mixture, annotators, or quality-control procedure for the scene subset. Natural-scene cases target seamless text integration into real environments such as signage on textured surfaces and shop fronts under complex lighting. Models generate images for the prompts, and Table 8 reports separate Poster and Real Scene scores plus their average. The report does not disclose the scorer, rubric, or exact aggregation protocol behind those internal scores.
